review_notes: I reviewed the whole file. It defines the connecting morphism triangleOfSESδ, the triangle triangleOfSES, an isomorphism triangleOfSESIso to the mapping-cone triangle, a distinguishedness lemma, and a map of triangles. I grepped Mathlib for other triangle constructions from short exact sequences and for other uses of these declarations. Only the single-object versions in SingleTriangle.lean and the functoriality lemmas in Ext/Map.lean use them, and these build on the target rather than competing with it. I found no independent Mathlib declaration representing the same concept. The mapping-cone triangle is the generic construction, and triangleOfSES is a named specialisation to short exact sequences, which the rubric says is not a defect.
